# E016 -- TikTok For Business Brand Guidelines

## Metadata
- **Company:** TikTok
- **Industry:** Social Media
- **Year:** (undated, estimated 2020-2021)
- **Source file:** TikTok_guidelines.pdf
- **Pages:** ~50+
- **Language:** EN
- **Pages sampled:** 1-2, 6-7, 12-13

## Brand Strategy
- "TikTok For Business" -- B2B sub-brand targeting marketers and advertisers
- Messaging-first structure: platform description, personality, tone of voice all precede design system
- Audience: marketers who need results
- Positioning: creative platform for brands with ROI focus

## Logo
- Two lockup options: horizontal (primary/preferred) and vertical (secondary, for portrait/tight applications)
- Social lockups provided separately
- Color variations defined
- Optical kerning, refined weight, defined clear space
- Partnership logo rules
- Placement and rotation guidelines
- Logo animation specifications
- Downloadable logo files referenced
- "Things to Avoid" section included

- Sofia Pro as primary brand typeface
- Sofia Pro Soft as secondary variant
- Substitute typefaces specified for both Sofia Pro and Sofia Pro Soft
- Typography system defined with hierarchy
- Headline treatment guidelines
- Localization considerations for global markets
- "Things to Avoid" section

- Photography guidelines with diversity emphasis
- Photography application examples

- Advertising guidelines (section 04): videos, stills, graphics, banners

## Tone of Voice
- Confident yet humble -- not bragging or cocky
- Playful -- but not trying too hard
- To the point -- with fun along the way
- Casual -- write the way people talk
- Provocative -- but never mean or derisive
- Do/Don't language examples:
  - DO: "Make it big on a small biz budget and maximize ROI"
  - DON'T: "Hit the big time without spending a lot of dolla dolla billz, y'all"
  - DO: "Grow your audience. Grow your brand. Make graphs go up."
  - DON'T: "Increase your audience and brand share of voice."
- Brand treatment in copy section (specific copy rules for brand name usage)

## Outliers
- B2B sub-brand guide rather than consumer brand -- targets marketers specifically
- Messaging before design -- content-first approach unusual in brand guides
- Tone of Voice language examples with direct Do/Don't comparisons -- exceptionally practical
- Diversity explicitly called out as a photography section -- progressive and intentional
- Logo animation section reflects digital-native brand
- Video rules section -- unique to a video-first platform
- Sofia Pro as brand typeface -- modern geometric sans-serif choice
- Advertising guidelines as dedicated section shows this is primarily a partner/advertiser toolkit
- Localization section under typography -- global brand considerations

## Quality Score
- **Score: 4/5** -- Well-structured, modern B2B brand guide with strong content-first approach. Excellent tone of voice section with practical do/don't examples. Comprehensive design toolkit (bubbles, patterns, emphasis marks) creates distinctive visual language. Good coverage of digital-native needs (animation, video, social lockups). Photography diversity section is forward-thinking. Loses a point for being a sub-brand guide (TikTok For Business) rather than the full consumer brand, which limits scope.
